title: Assert the first-closing premise and observed check outcome in pinned launcher tests
outcome: Pinned launcher tests explicitly fail when the first-close checkpoint premise, null closing source change or ordinary observed check result stops matching the behavior they are intended to witness.
acceptance: The first-closing pinned witness asserts that no compatible prior checkpoint exists and that its closing report has no source change after an unchanged registered check.

Pinned launcher checks assert the ordinary observed check passes through the applicable completion validator on Windows Node and non-Windows Cargo, alongside the existing native record, receipt and evaluation assertions.
